_doc: Map storefront product slugs → Tamashii Web item IDs.
When a slug appears here, the Tamashii adapter fetches
https://tamashiiweb.com/item/<id>/?wovn=en and extracts the full
gallery (8-10 high-res photos) + release year + EN title.
Two override shapes:
Existing product (slug already in `products` table):
"unicorn-cloth": "12345"
New product to be created as draft (slug NOT in `products`):
"medical-machine": {
"line": "myth-cloth-ex",  /* required: product_lines slug */
"name": "Override name"   /* optional: defaults to Tamashii title */
Draft products are inserted with status='draft' and hidden from the
storefront. After the proposals are approved + price/condition set
in /admin/products/<id>, flip status to 'available' to publish.
Older products with no live Tamashii page: leave them out; the
Fandom + eBay adapters still work via name search.
_batches groups slugs so you can run a focused crawl:
npm run crawl:apply -- --batch=dbs-super-hero
Pure metadata — entries are still resolved through the flat
`overrides` map. Add new batches as you import new lines.
